description: Agent Water Records: submit a utility’s discharge monitoring records with the outfall list, discharge limits and monitoring reports they answer to: the reading moment; each outfall the discharge record lists with its id, reference and name; each discharge limit with its id, reference, the outfall, the parameter and the maximum it allows; each monitoring sample with its id, reference, the outfall, the parameter, the value measured and the moment sampled; each monitoring report with its id, reference, the outfall, the parameter, the moments its period starts and ends, the period maximum it states and the moments it is due and was submitted. The signed report gives the discharges and the records behind them, each sample against the outfalls the record lists, each sample against the discharge limit for its outfall and parameter, each report’s period maximum against the highest sample in its period, and each report due against a submission date, and counts them, and names divergent water discharge records: a monitoring sample at an outfall the discharge record does not list, a sample above the discharge limit the record states, a report maximum the samples in its period do not support, and a monitoring report due with no submission recorded; then a report submitted after its due date and a report period holding no sample of its outfall and parameter, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No monitoring samples, or no limits or outfall list beside samples, leaves those points unverified. Outfalls, samples and reports match by letters and digits, parameters by their words with plurals folded, figures as written in the unit the record uses, periods and dates by the day, a sample equal to its limit is inside it, and a report due after the reading moment waits. This reads effluent monitoring records held by the utility that discharges: wever_waste-manifest-check reads waste and sludge manifests against the hauler and disposal records, while the discharge record check reads the utility’s own monitoring at its outfalls. Verdict water_discharge_record_divergent, water_discharge_record_partial, water_discharge_record_unverified or water_discharge_record_consistent. POST /api/water-discharge-record-check. Reads the water records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no system, takes no sample, contacts no regulator, customer or other utility and issues no certification, approval or water right decision, which stay with the utility, its operators and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Water Records reads records held by a water utility or water system operator: water system records with operator certifications, water quality test records from the sampling chain to the results, treatment plant records, discharge monitoring records, meter records, backflow test records and well records, and a water right’s own record, whoever holds it, each against the facility, certification, connection and survey records, the sampling plan, holding times and limits, the operating log, chemical stock and calibrations, the outfalls, discharge limits and monitoring reports, the reading history, the assembly, repair and tester records, the registration, construction and closure records, or the diversions and reported use on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the water system: what the system record lists, what the sampling chain and the treatment log support, what the discharge, meter and backflow records show, and whether the well and water right records hold up; it reads by record holder, not by the water itself: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s irrigation and water-use records against its allocation, the Agent Energy family reads utility bills and tariffs, and the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads waste manifests and disposal records, while this family reads the utility’s, the operator’s and the right’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-water-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-water-records/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

limits.description: Each discharge limit the record states.

maximum.description: Amount the limit allows, in the unit the record uses.

outfalls.description: Each outfall the discharge record lists.

due_at.description: When the report is due, such as 2026-03-02.

from.description: When the period starts, such as 2026-03-02.

reported.description: Amount the report states as the period maximum, in the unit the record uses.

to.description: When the period ends, such as 2026-03-02.

value.description: Amount measured, in the unit the record uses.
